title: Canelo arrives at Riyadh hotel, says rested and ready for fight with Mbilli
summary: Mexican boxer Saul "Canelo" Alvarez arrived in Riyadh early on Monday (October 26) and said he is rested and ready for his upcoming fight against WBC super middleweight champion Christian M'billi.
